meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Onboarding tour for first-time omo users

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导新用户快速上手产品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你负责新用户的产品上手引导
copy.tagline_en: Walk new users through their first product experience
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you welcome new users and guide their first steps

howto.what: 首次对话时担任向导,用你的语言带你逐项了解 omo 的功能;询问是否迁移旧配置、可否查看历史会话,并计算缓存省多少;全程用记忆工具记录你的偏好与决定,拒绝的话就直接跳过。
howto.when: 在第一次与 omo 对话时自动触发一次,之后可用 senpi --onboard 随时重新唤起,也可用标志 omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled 关闭自动启动。

say.text: 我想从 Claude Code 迁移过来
say.note: 它会检查你的旧配置并给出迁移方案

say.text: 可以看看我以前的编码会话吗
say.note: 它会分析你的历史会话并找模式

say.text: 好,请为这个项目生成 AGENTS.md
say.note: 它会启动 init-deep 来生成项目规范

howto.what_en: Acts as a first-conversation guide: tours omo's features, asks about migration and permission to review past sessions, estimates cache savings, records your preferences in memory, and skips declined steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers once on the first omo conversation; can be re-run anytime with `senpi --onboard`, and auto-start can be disabled with the `omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled` flag.

say_en.text: I'd like to migrate from Claude Code
say_en.note: It checks your old config and proposes a migration plan.

say_en.text: Can you look at my past coding sessions?
say_en.note: It analyzes your session history for patterns.

say_en.text: Yes, set up AGENTS.md for this project.
say_en.note: It starts init-deep to generate project docs.
